biggest_gap: Environmental storytelling and stickman integration. The reference builds HD 188753 Ab as a PLACE the viewer inhabits through the stickman's eyes - standing on surfaces, reacting to alien skies, experiencing the confusion of multiple suns. Ours presents it as a series of isolated diagrams and facts floating on purple backgrounds. The t=28 frame (pair 5) is the most decisive loss: a conceptual/emotional beat ('quoting the spirit not the letter') that DEMANDS the stickman's reaction, and ours dropped to pure text. Per CLAUDE.md §6, 'Every segment must have the stickman in at least one beat, and the segment's tone must be readable from his face alone.' Round 5 fails this requirement - no stickman appears in any sampled frame. The reference has him in 3 of 6 frames, each with a distinct emotional read (confused at t=12, uncomfortable/skeptical at t=38). The gap is not style fidelity or layout discipline - it's the complete absence of the emotional anchor that makes Paint Explainer videos work.
